Name: Freshwater Tilapia
Author: TrentXV
Description: Changes Tilapia spawning location as they are fresh water fish irl, now they will spawn at river Town+Forest and Forest Lake, it does not change the time or the behavior, also changes the Ocean Fish Bundle - now instead of a Tilapia you will need an Albacore . The iridium quality shown in the picture is a feature of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2360?tab=description]Everlasting Baits and Unbreakable Tackles MOD[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2186381]Digus[/url].
